## The rules

- [ ] Open source: an OSI-approved license, with a LICENSE file in the repo.
- [ ] A real GUI: a desktop app for Windows, macOS or Linux, or a self-hosted web app. Not command-line only.
- [ ] A downloadable release exists: a release, installer, or store or package listing.
- [ ] Nothing for sale: no Pro tier, trial, subscription, paid add-ons, paid cloud, sync or hosting, enterprise edition, paid commercial license or in-app ads.
- [ ] Donations, if any, block nothing now and can't later.
- [ ] Active: a commit or release in the last 12 months.
- [ ] It does the main job of well-known paid software.
- [ ] It isn't already listed, and I checked EXCLUDED.md.

## The data

- [ ] I edited the files in `data/`, not README.md, REPLACES.md or EXCLUDED.md.
- [ ] I filled in every `evidence` field.
- [ ] I ran `python scripts/build.py` and `python scripts/check.py`, and committed the regenerated files.
